title: theta-resonance + epi-sigillin: Brain Oscillation Bands & Epigenetic Runtime Parameter Mutation (GenesisAeon Packages 27+28)
description: Packages 27 and 28 of the GenesisAeon Entropy Atlas. Package 27 (theta-resonance): models EEG frequency bands (delta/theta/alpha/beta/gamma) as CREP modulation channels within the Unified Threshold Activation Criticality (UTAC) framework. Confirms Γ_theta ≈ 0.251 = Γ_AMOC = Γ_neural_criticality — the triple homeostatic universality prediction. Package 28 (epi-sigillin): implements epigenetic mutation of UTAC/CREP parameters during runtime. Analogous to DNA methylation and histone modification, the system entropy level rewrites CREP-YAML parameter files at runtime — high entropy epochs methylate (suppress) CREP-P, low entropy epochs de-methylate (activate) CREP-E. Includes CREPMethylationEngine, HistoneModificationModel, RuntimeYAMLMutator, EpigeneticMemory, and full Diamond-Template contract. Both packages implement: run_cycle / get_crep_state / get_utac_state / get_phase_events / to_zenodo_record.
